description: This file defines the MatchDetailsFragment class, which is an Android fragment responsible for displaying detailed information about a sports match, including teams, logos, score, and highlights. It uses Android's Leanback library and Coil for image loading.

classes.name: MatchDetailsFragment
classes.description: Main fragment displaying match details and highlights action.

classes.name: DetailsDescriptionPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for binding description text in details view.

classes.name: DetailsInfo
classes.description: Data class holding info about a match, including logo URLs.

classes.name: DetailsInfoPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for displaying detailed info including team logos.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up image loader, retrieves match info from arguments, configures UI components.

methods.name: onBindDescription
methods.description: Binds the match description to the UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the custom view for displaying detailed info.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Populates view with match info and loads team logos.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the view holder is unbound.
